notes: Zone = the City of Twin Falls' City Limits layer as published (one polygon with its 12 county holes; layer last edited 2023-08-09). Ride TFT told Atlas Outreach (CIV-1452) the zone is the city limits plus the municipal airport (Joslin Field) and Shoshone Falls Park; both are outside the city limits and have no official boundary file yet, so they are pending a source from the City (requested through Outreach). Do not add them from parcels or the 2016 parks-plan layer. Hours, holidays and booking from ridetft.com/start-riding (2026-11-13); open to anyone (ridetft.com/about). Pickup method is not stated, so it is left out. After-hours and airport rides ($10) are not drawn.
